stemMd:
Is the positive integer n divisible by 6?

(1) n is divisible by 3.

(2) n is even.

Which assessment of sufficiency is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Even together the statements are not sufficient.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Together the statements are sufficient, but neither is sufficient alone.

explanationMd: Multiples of 3 can be odd or even, and even numbers need not be multiples of 3. Together the statements force divisibility by the relatively prime factors 2 and 3, hence by 6.

distractorRationale.b: Assess each statement separately before combining them. Multiples of 3 can be odd or even, and even numbers need not be multiples of 3. Together the statements force divisibility by the relatively prime factors 2 and 3, hence by 6.
